extra.message: The user-supplied 'username' query parameter (read_root's username argument, sourced from the request query string) is concatenated directly into a Jinja2 template string passed to Environment.from_string(), which compiles and renders it as a live template. This is a Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) vulnerability. An attacker can supply Jinja2 template syntax (e.g. ?username={{ ''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__() }}) to execute arbitrary Python code on the server, leading to remote code execution. Additionally, Environment() is created with the default autoescape=False, so the rendered output returned via HTMLResponse is also reflected unescaped, enabling reflected XSS. The safe implementation (commented out on line 17) passes the value as a render context variable instead of concatenating it into the template source.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine
